source_conclusion: The complete two-file/three-hunk menu lazy-view fix is adapted to the locally owned historical menu. The earlier immediate-overlay-detach implementation could not paint an exit; that defect was repaired separately while preserving the Material16 template/style and public constructor contracts. Current semantic close releases focus/input immediately, then only the current owner detaches overlay and lazy content on void/completion; transfer cancels old removal and releases the old view before attaching the new owner. Genuine Core/RxJS constructor protocols exercise lifetime/reentry but are not native or packed qualification. The required packed case observes actual query membership, directive destruction, distinct re-created items and two-trigger transfer. All native CSS exit cases and global motion gates remain independently mandatory; no painting/timing, hydration, floor, security or G11 pass follows from this source conclusion.
